`Field` now treats occupancy uniformly through `Movable`.

What changed:
- Added a shared [Movable.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Movable.java) contract and [OccupancyLayer.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/OccupancyLayer.java) to describe whether an occupant belongs in the animal or plant layer.
- Replaced `placeAnimal(...)` and `placePlant(...)` with a single [Field.place(Movable, Location)](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Field.java#L47) API, plus the row/column overload.
- Kept movement encapsulated in [Field.move(...) ](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Field.java#L52), which now routes through the unified placement path.
- Updated the internal cell logic in [Field.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Field.java#L149) so it stores and clears occupants by `OccupancyLayer`, not by registration method.
- Made [Entity.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Entity.java#L4) implement `Movable`, so entities delegate occupancy management to `Field` without knowing cell details.
